nanda_diagnosis.label: Ineffective peripheral tissue perfusion / Neuro-ocular risk

allied_health_actions.nursing: Perform Amsler grid visual test and log cephalad fluid-shift symptoms.
allied_health_actions.nutrition: Reduce dietary sodium to mitigate intracranial fluid retention.
allied_health_actions.physiotherapy: Execute scheduled lower-body negative pressure / aerobic session.

clinical_rules.immediate_action: Run Amsler grid test, cut sodium intake, and transmit SOAP summary to Flight Surgeon.

allied_health_actions.nursing: Switch cabin lighting to warm spectrum and log sleep duration.
allied_health_actions.psychology: Run 4-7-8 guided breathing and schedule async family check-in.

clinical_rules.immediate_action: Dim blue light, execute 4-7-8 breathing protocol, and adjust rest schedule.

allied_health_actions.nursing: Relocate to shielded spacecraft module and apply moisturizing barrier.
allied_health_actions.pharmacy: Verify medical kit radiation exposure before administering topical/oral agents.

clinical_rules.medical_hypothesis: Acute skin reaction or elevated cumulative radiation exposure
clinical_rules.immediate_action: Move to shielded module, verify med-kit potency, and capture follow-up skin photo in 12h.

allied_health_actions.nutrition: Consume 500mL fractionated electrolyte solution to prevent renal calculi.
allied_health_actions.nursing: Repeat contactless webcam rPPG pulse check in 30 minutes.

clinical_rules.immediate_action: Sip 500mL electrolyte solution and repeat video rPPG check in 30 minutes.

allied_health_actions.physiotherapy: Perform graded seated-to-standing protocol and vestibular gaze stabilization.
allied_health_actions.nursing: Monitor orthostatic blood pressure and hold EVA clearance until nominal.

clinical_rules.immediate_action: Remain seated, begin graded physiotherapy readaptation, and hold EVA clearance.
